minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, May 9, 2024
  6:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  May 9, 2024 / 6:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Director of Community Services Stephanie Harris, Director
  of Community Development Michael Forbes, NEXT Beverly Hills
  Committee Chair Charles Smith, NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Vice Chair
  Ellen Labbe

  1) Public Comment:
  a. A

  2) Welcome & Introductions:
  a. Dan Bald: Attorney

  3) NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement:
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills is a committee of talented next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in
  their 20s, 30s, and 40s chartered by the mayor and the city of Beverly Hills that
  seeks to engage all that are interested to inspire them and to make Beverly Hills a
  better place for all.

  4) New Business:
  a. Presentation by Michael Forbes:
  i. The Community Development Department deals with everything related to
  development, such as planning, the general plan, the zoning code, building
  permits, building inspections, code enforcement, film & special event
  permits, and the rent stabilization committee.
  ii. The Mandarin Oriental Residences has 54 units and is located on 9200
  Wilshire Blvd. It recently completed construction and is currently welcoming
  new tenants.
  iii. The Rosewood Residences will have 17 condo units and is located at 9900
  S. Santa Monica Blvd. It is currently under construction.
  iv. Dior is currently building a 4-story retail building with a top floor restaurant
  at 319 N. Rodeo Dr.
 Highlights for May 9, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  v. Gearys is building a 3-story retail building at 312 N. Rodeo Dr.
  vi. Bulgari is building a 3-story retail building at 401 N. Rodeo Dr.
  vii. There is also a 3-story office building under construction at 317 N. Beverly
  Dr.
  viii. One Beverly Hills just started construction and is expected to be completed
  around 2028. It will have 2 condominium towers with 255 units, a new
  luxury hotel, and new conference facilities for the Hilton. There will also be
  a 5-acre park that will be open to the public.
  ix. Projects that have been approved but have not started construction:
  1. 55 N. La Cienega: 105 units, 11 very low income, mixed use
  2. 9229 Wilshire Blvd: 56 units, 6 very low income
  3. Saks Specific plan: 9600 Wilshire Blvd, 70 residential units, office
  space, retail space, restaurant space, & a social club with a hotel.
  The public comment for this project ends on May 20th.
  x. The Housing Element is the housing plan for 2021-2029 which was certified
  on May 1st, which demonstrates that the city has the planning and zoning
  capacity to accommodate 3,104 additional housing units. This will be done
  through mixed use overlay zones, promoting and allowing accessory
  dwelling units in single family areas, and building affordable housing on city
  owned properties.
  xi. 19 applications were submitted using builder’s remedy prior to the
  certification of the housing element. These applications still need to be
  evaluated and there are currently legal battles ongoing about the limits of
  builder’s remedy.
  b.  One Beverly Hills was approved through a specific plan, which allowed for special
  zoning requirements, including height requirements, for just the site in question.
  c.  Legally affordable housing may not necessarily be affordable for the workforce due
  to the legally affordable housing being outside of the price range of the workforce.
  d.  Developers are taking advantage of the density bonus, which allows developers to
  set aside a certain number of units for low or moderate-income housing in
  exchange for being allowed to build taller buildings with more units and less
  parking.
  e.  PATH housing is different from Affordable housing units.

 iii.  Next Night 2024 Updates
  a. Two dates have been proposed for Next Night 2024, the first being Saturday
  September 28th and the second being Saturday October 26th.
  b. Staff recommends the September date due to it not conflicting with any Jewish
  holidays.

  5) City Council Liaison Update – Civic Awareness Update:
  a. There are several commission vacancies that need to be filled. Applications to fill
  these positions are due by May 17th at 5 PM.
  b. The commissions open are the Charitable Solicitations Commission with 1
  vacancy, the Architectural Commission with 1 vacancy, the Cultural Heritage
 Highlights for May 9, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  Commission with 2 vacancies, the Arts and Culture Commission has 1 vacancy,
  the Health & Safety Commission has 1 vacancy, and the Traffic & Parking
  Commission also has 1 vacancy.
  c. The meetings for each commission occur either on a monthly or quarterly basis.
  d. Only residents can apply for the position.
  e. With the onboarding of 4 firefighters earlier in the day, the Fire Department is now
  at full capacity.

  6) City Staff Announcements and Upcoming Events for the Next Generation:
  a. This Saturday from 1-4 PM is Fire Service Day at the fire station.
  b. Next weekend on Saturday and Sunday is the Beverly Hills Art Show in Beverly
  Gardens Park.

  7) Current Business:
  a. None

  8) Post Meeting Networking Session (Off-Site)

  9) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: May 9, 2024 / 7:23 PM
